run_streamlit_demo: run the streamlit MLGym demo app to replay agent experiment trajectories in a browser
load_trajectory: load a JSON trajectory file and return the list of agent steps from the trajectory
display_steps: display and animate each step of an ML agent trajectory with thought, action, and result panels
highlight_step_keywords: highlight action, analysis, performance, error, and optimization keywords in step caption text using regex
stream_text: stream text character by character into a Streamlit placeholder with optional code block formatting
